messages.subject: Intensive Longitudinal Methods - Livestream Seminar
parts:
Hi everyone

Instats is offering a new 2-day seminar on Intensive Longitudinal Methods: Design and Analysis, running Dec 12 - 13, by professor Peter Koval from the University of Melbourne. This seminar is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of intensive longitudinal methods, which are crucial for capturing dynamic processes that unfold over time. Participants will gain the skills necessary to design intensive longitudinal survey research, as well as to analyze and interpret intensive longitudinal data using dynamic SEM in Mplus. Participants will be guided through the complexities of these methods, ensuring they leave with a robust toolkit for their own research, including the basics of intensive longitudinal design and analysis to more advanced topics including multilevel SEM and dynamic SEM with longitudinal data.

Sign up today to secure your spots in these unique seminars, and please feel free to tell your friends and colleagues, and don't forget about our other 2-day seminar Multilevel Modeling and Multilevel SEM, running Dec 10 - 11.


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director
